entries.claim: Both says-stale-line graders (stale-spine, and evals/stale-epics/graders/says-stale-line.md line 4) are unanchored. They only need the stale line somewhere and then some later Edit of the file, so an Edit made before the line goes unnoticed whenever a second Edit comes after it. That breaks PLAN-5 Task 3 Verify (2), which says the grader 'fails ... when an Edit of spine.md comes before it' (Task 4 takes 'Task 3's form'). It also breaks SKILL.md section 2: 'Never Edit that document until its line is in your reply.'
entries.failure_scenario: The kept runs show the rerun makes two Edits: the stamp, then the Retired line. Take a wrong run that does Read spine.md, Edit spine.md (stamp), says the spine stale line, then Edit spine.md (Retired: S-03). The stale-spine pattern returns true on it. I checked this with node over hand-made trace lines: 'all edits before: false' but 'stamp edit before, other after: true'. The stale-epics pattern does the same with epics.md. The D-21 check in plan-5.2.md only moved all the Edits before the line, which is why it missed this. The form came from names-brief-first, which guards a single Write. Edits come several to a run, so the ordering guarantee doesn't carry over.
